authenticity_review: The image exhibits high photorealism in lighting and texture (brass reflections, wax translucency) but suffers from severe structural hallucinations typical of AI generation. The valve mechanisms on the instruments are mechanically impossible, with buttons and casings that do not connect logically to the tubing. Additionally, the interface where the candles enter the bells shows unnatural fusion/melting rather than a physical insertion. These structural defects significantly reduce authenticity despite the clean surface rendering.
key_defects: Structural collapse in trumpet valve mechanisms (non-functional geometry)
